overview: FlowRL shifts LLM reinforcement learning from reward maximization to reward distribution matching via flow balancing, using a learnable partition function to normalize scalar rewards into a target distribution and minimizing reverse KL divergence with trajectory balance objectives, incorporating length normalization and importance sampling for stable long chain-of-thought training.

modules.name: Partition Function Zϕ Module
modules.description: Implements the learnable partition function Zϕ(x) as a 3-layer MLP that takes the mean of the language model's final-layer hidden states over the prompt tokens and outputs a scalar value. This module normalizes scalar rewards into a valid probability distribution, enabling the conversion from reward maximization to distribution matching. Includes initialization, forward pass, and gradient flow management for Zϕ.

modules.name: Reward Processing & Normalization Module
modules.description: Handles outcome-based reward processing including group-level reward normalization (subtracting mean and dividing by standard deviation across a sampled group), reference model log-probability incorporation for reward shaping, and the β-scaled reward redefinition that combines normalized rewards with the reference model prior as specified in the energy-based formulation.

modules.name: Trajectory Balance Objective Module
modules.description: Implements the core FlowRL loss function derived from minimizing reverse KL divergence via the trajectory balance formulation. Computes the squared loss term combining the partition function log, length-normalized policy log-probability, β-scaled normalized reward, and length-normalized reference model log-probability. Validates the gradient equivalence between KL minimization and trajectory balance as established in Proposition 1.

modules.name: Length Normalization Module
modules.description: Addresses gradient explosion in long chain-of-thought reasoning by normalizing sequence-level log-probabilities with respect to trajectory length. Applies 1/|y| rescaling to both the policy log-probability term and the reference model log-probability term within the trajectory balance objective, ensuring balanced gradient contributions across variable-length CoT responses up to 8K tokens.

modules.name: Importance Sampling & Clipping Module
modules.description: Corrects for distribution mismatch between stale rollouts from old policy and current policy during training. Computes trajectory-level importance ratios with detached gradients, applies PPO-style clipping to bound importance weights, and integrates the clipped weights as multiplicative factors in the surrogate loss. Ensures stable off-policy updates while preventing excessive policy drift.

modules.name: FlowRL Training Loop Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the complete training workflow including rollout generation with group sampling (n=8 rollouts per prompt), micro-batch updates, joint optimization of policy parameters θ and partition function parameters ϕ, and coordination between the policy model, reference model, and partition function. Handles training step management, convergence checking, and early stopping based on evaluation metrics.

modules.name: Data Loading & Rollout Sampling Module
modules.description: Implements dataset handling for math (DAPO training set) and code (DeepCoder training set) domains. Manages prompt batching, group-based rollout generation where each prompt produces multiple responses from the current/old policy, response truncation to max response length, and dynamic batch sizing. Supports both on-policy and off-policy sampling modes required by different algorithm variants.

modules.name: Baseline Algorithm Implementations
modules.description: Provides reference implementations of REINFORCE++, PPO (with critic model and advantage estimation), and GRPO (with group advantage normalization, clipping, and KL regularization) following official veRL recipes. Ensures consistent training configurations across baselines for fair comparison, including identical learning rates, batch sizes, and training steps evaluated at convergence.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Module
modules.description: Computes all evaluation metrics used in the paper: Avg@16 (average Pass@1 accuracy over 16 rollouts) for math and code benchmarks, CodeForces rating and percentile ranking, and relative improvement calculations. Handles generation with sampling parameters (temperature, top-p) and response length constraints consistent with training configurations.

modules.name: Diversity Analysis Module
modules.description: Implements solution diversity assessment using GPT-4o-mini as a judge with the detailed 1-5 scoring rubric evaluating the variety of solution approaches across rollouts. Also supports human evaluation with a 1-3 scoring scale. Computes per-method diversity scores for AIME problems, enabling quantitative comparison of exploration patterns across FlowRL and baseline methods.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Supports controlled ablation experiments including: (1) importance sampling removal/replacement with combined GFlowNets+PPO loss, (2) β hyperparameter sensitivity analysis across multiple values, (3) partition function Zϕ architectural variants (depth, removal, constant replacement), and (4) length normalization ablation demonstrating training instability. Provides structured configuration for component-wise isolation studies.

modules.name: Distributed Training Infrastructure
modules.description: Supports multi-node multi-GPU training using veRL framework, scaling from single-node 8-GPU setup (7B models) to 4-node 32-GPU setup (32B models). Handles model parallelism for large models, gradient synchronization, distributed rollout generation, and memory-efficient training with mixed precision for 80GB GPU memory constraints.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration & Logging Module
modules.description: Manages all hyperparameter configurations (learning rate, batch sizes, rollout counts, β, clipping epsilon, KL coefficients), training metadata logging (reward statistics, response lengths, gradient norms, AIME accuracy during training), and experiment tracking via Wandb or TensorBoard. Supports reward distribution variance analysis and training dynamics visualization.

modules.name: Result Aggregation & Report Generation Module
modules.description: Aggregates evaluation results across all benchmarks (6 math, 3 code), generates comparison tables with relative improvements (color-coded positive/negative changes), produces performance plots (KL divergence comparison, diversity score bar charts, training dynamics curves), and compiles cross-domain evaluation results (MMLU, GPQA). Supports automated LaTeX table generation and statistical result formatting.
